summary.text: Matt Roach is a Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Cheshire 15, a two-seat district, in the November 3, 2026 general election, alongside Becky Shields; they face incumbent Democrats Samantha Jacobs and Nicholas Germana.

paragraphs.text: Matt Roach has run for the House before. In 2020 he and Jerry Sickels won the Republican primary for the two-seat Cheshire 16 district but lost the general election to Joe Schapiro and Amanda Toll.
In 2022 he lost the Republican primary for Cheshire 4 to Thomas Savastano.
In 2026 he and Becky Shields defeated Jerry Sickels in the Republican primary for Cheshire 15 on September 8.
